# spotlight_harness_profile (Resource)

A team's harness settings, which a station names in `profile`: permissions every harness is told in its own terms, MCP servers, and each harness's own settings passed through as it reads them. Where a harness cannot say a rule, the answer's warnings name the approximation. Import it as `<workspace id>/<team key>/<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spotlight_harness_profile" "core_careful" {
  team_id = spotlight_team.core.id
  key     = "careful"
  permissions = {
    allow = ["read", "edit", "execute(npm test *)"]
    ask   = ["execute(git push *)"]
    deny  = ["read(.env)"]
  }
  mcp_servers = [
    {
      name    = "linear"
      command = "npx"
      args    = ["-y", "linear-mcp"]
      env     = { LINEAR_WORKSPACE = "acme" }
    },
  ]
  native = {
    claude-code = {
      includeCoAuthoredBy = false
    }
    codex = "model_verbosity = \"low\"\n"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) What stations name the profile by, as in `careful`. It is fixed for the harness profile's life, so changing it replaces the harness profile.
- `team_id` (String) The team the harness profile belongs to. Changing it replaces the harness profile.

### Optional

- `mcp_servers` (Attributes List) Stdio MCP servers, handed to each harness in its own format. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mcp_servers))
- `native` (Dynamic) Each harness's own settings by harness, passed through as it reads them: Claude Code settings as an object, Codex `config.toml` as text, Cursor CLI config as an object; as in `{ claude-code = { includeCoAuthoredBy = false } }`.
- `permissions` (Attributes) What the harness may do, what it asks a person about first, and what it may never do. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the resource within its workspace, as in `core/careful`.
- `id` (String) Issued by Spotlight when the harness profile is created, and never changed.
- `version` (Number) Rises with every change to the harness profile; each write sends it back so a change made since is not overwritten.

<a id="nestedatt--mcp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mcp_servers`

Required:

- `command` (String) What starts the server, as in `npx`.
- `name` (String) Names the server, in lower case words joined by dashes, as in `linear`.

Optional:

- `args` (List of String) What the command is given.
- `env` (Map of String) The server's environment. A value is plain text, stored and shown as written, or a reference to a workspace secret such as `secret.LINEAR_API_KEY`: the secret must exist, cannot be deleted while referenced, and reaches the server only as a stand-in, since egress wears its value on the server's requests to the hosts it is bound to.


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Optional:

- `allow` (List of String) What the harness may do without asking. Each is `read`, `edit` or `execute`, alone or with a pattern, as in `execute(npm test *)` or `read(.env)`.
- `ask` (List of String) What the harness asks a person about first; the ask reaches their inbox as an approval. Each is `read`, `edit` or `execute`, alone or with a pattern, as in `execute(npm test *)` or `read(.env)`.
- `deny` (List of String) What the harness may never do. Each is `read`, `edit` or `execute`, alone or with a pattern, as in `execute(npm test *)` or `read(.env)`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_harness_profile.core_careful
  identity = {
    id = "3f8a1c2e-6b4d-4e7a-9c1f-0d2b5e8a7c63"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The id Spotlight issued the harness profile when it was created.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_harness_profile.core_careful
  id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core/careful"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A harness profile is imported by its workspace's id and its address, <team key>/<key>.
terraform import spotlight_harness_profile.core_careful 5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core/careful
```
